summary.text: Great Space Temple is Chi clan's stronger Immortal Gu House, a rank eight house ranked ninth among Immortal Gu Houses in the five regions chaotic war list Fang Yuan recalls. From outside it is pure white and round like marble, with golden accents.

claims.text: When Fang Yuan sends great thief ghost hand at Chi clan’s Immortal Gu House in cloud bamboo mountain range, the house’s surface shines with golden light and a spiral of ripples absorbs the hand, cutting his connection. He names the house Great Space Temple and treats it as one of the top ten Immortal Gu Houses. Chi clan has two Immortal Gu Houses; this one can resist rank eight Gu Immortals.

It has a move called moving space domain that can trap rank eight Gu Immortals, and in a Heavenly Court attack on Southern Border that house trapped four rank sevens and two rank eights. Fang Yuan judges that great thief ghost hand was caught in moving space domain, notes that the move normally needs preparation time, and sees that Chi clan answered too quickly to be unprepared. Under Chi clan Gu Immortals’ control, rank eight Great Space Temple erupts and suppresses him; he leaves with Fixed Immortal Travel rather than stay under that pressure. Great Space Temple is not an immortal battlefield, even if it holds an immortal battlefield killer move.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Great Space Temple is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment of Chi clan, not a five-region map seat.

When he later targets other Immortal Gu Houses with great thief ghost hand, he recalls that he had aimed that move at Great Space Temple before, and that this house had a method that resisted it, unlike most houses.

Chi Qu You later leads Great Space Temple on an expedition after Fang Yuan’s raids, and after splitting forces he sends the space path Immortal Gu House Great Space Temple toward ragged cave while he goes to Wind Flame Mountain.

Great Space Temple counters immortal battlefields; Fang Yuan had fought it in his previous life, and even great thief ghost hand could not counter it, so he prefers to lure Chi Qu You out alone rather than face the house.
